title:
We resolved the merge conflict
by flipping a nickel.
Heads was `ours`. Tails was `theirs`.
subtitle: It landed on tails. As a direct mathematical consequence, the routing table was deleted, the database connection pool was replaced with a string array, and all 404 pages now render this confession.
logs: > CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in routes.ts (942 conflicting lines).
> opening VS Code merge conflict editor...
> option B: 'Accept Incoming Change' (also looks scary).
> option C: 'Accept Both Changes' (guaranteed syntax catastrophe).
footnote: Error code: `COINFLIP-CHAOS-404` · Probability of breakage: 100% · Due diligence: None
pathTemplate: The route handler for `{path}` was lost in a coin-toss conflict resolution on main.
